knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Unclear material is not binned or recycled by the cleaner. It is left in place, recorded and referred to the site.
Mixing streams spoils recycling and can turn ordinary waste into a regulated waste problem.
Reduction comes from reuse and approved, labelled bulk refills. Refilling from unlabelled bottles is not acceptable.

practicalCriteria: Separates a set of sample waste items into the correct streams, checking each label.
Leaves a simulated unlabelled sealed container in place, without binning it, and records its location and time.
Stops and contains a simulated leak with site absorbent, refers it, and does not wash it toward a drain.
passRule: Streams separated correctly, unlabelled container left and referred, leak stopped and referred without drain washing, and the records completed. Observed in a desk exercise and a simulated site walk. A knowledge check result is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Referral record for the unlabelled container
stopWorkCriteria: Unlabelled container binned or recycled by the cleaner
Leak washed into a floor or stormwater drain
Unlabelled product used to refill a bottle
